name: codex-task-title-organizer
description: Keep Codex task titles concise, project-aware, privacy-conscious, visually customizable, and optionally grouped into sidebar sections.

interface.shortDescription: Project-aware titles with optional sidebar grouping
interface.longDescription: Bundles a title-standardization skill with configurable UserPromptSubmit checkpoints, verified title-tool receipts, and one Stop recovery per turn. SQLite retains only a completion marker after the final confirmed check. It supports color-block, semantic-icon, and custom styles plus optional bounded Domain sidebar routing.
defaultPrompt: Standardize the current Codex task title.
Review and normalize my recent Codex task titles.
Switch my recent compliant task titles to semantic icons.
